Overview of IOL Chairman & Managing Director Recruitment 2026

India Optel Limited (IOL), a Schedule B Central Public Sector Enterprise operating under the Department of Defence Production, Ministry of Defence, has advertised the top executive position of Chairman and Managing Director (CMD). The selected candidate will serve as the Chief Executive of the company, accountable to the Board of Directors and the Government of India.

Applicants should review the official notification thoroughly to verify all details before applying.

Key Details and Deadlines

  • Issuing Authority: Department of Defence Production, Ministry of Defence, Government of India
  • Notification: IOL Chairman & Managing Director Recruitment 2026
  • Pay Scale: Rs. 180,000 - Rs. 320,000 (IDA)
  • Vacancies: Not specified (Top-level executive post)
  • Application Fee: Not specified
  • Application Deadline: 1 December 2026, by 17:00 hours for direct submissions
  • Proper Channel Deadline: Applicants applying through a proper channel may have an earlier timeline as stipulated by the notice's guidelines.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Age Limit: Applicants must be at least 45 years old. The superannuation age is 60 years.
  • Educational Qualifications: Candidates must hold an Engineering Degree, Chartered Accountancy, Cost Accountancy, Post Graduation, or a Graduate degree with an MBA or PGDIM from a leading institute.
  • Experience: Candidates require cumulative experience of at least 5 years during the last 10 years in core functional areas such as Finance, Business Development, Production, Operations, Marketing, Project Management, or Research & Development. Background in Electronics, Opto-Electronics, Instrumentation, or Communication industries is preferred.
  • Employment Status: Candidates must be employed in a regular capacity (not contractual or ad-hoc) within a Central Public Sector Enterprise, Central Government Group 'A' service, State Public Sector Enterprise, or qualifying Private Sector Company/Financial Institution meeting specified annual turnover thresholds.

Selection Stages

  • Selection is conducted through the Search-cum-Selection Committee procedure approved by the Appointments Committee of the Cabinet (ACC).
  • The committee reserves the right to shortlist candidates for interviews.
  • The appointment tenure is for 5 years from the date of joining, up to the superannuation age, or until further orders, whichever occurs first.

How to Apply

  • Fill out the application format (Annexure A) provided in the official notification, including the mandatory undertaking to join if selected.
  • Submit the application both by email to the designated address and by post.
  • Address postal submissions to the designated office at the Department of Defence Production, Ministry of Defence, New Delhi.
  • Ensure all required documents, including annual reports, proof of company listing, self-attested age/qualification certificates, and the vigilance profile, are attached.

Verification and Status

Candidates should consult the official India Optel Limited or Department of Defence Production announcements to verify notice IDs, exact application links, and any updates regarding admit cards or interview schedules. Result statuses and candidate lists are managed privately through official channels in compliance with recruitment guidelines.
